moved.sentence: Adopt **CQRS** when one of these is concretely true:

judged.note: Kept: the rule restricts CQRS adoption to when one of the same two triggers (measured divergent read/write scaling or shape; read side needing independent storage or indexing) is concretely true, matching the old section's 'adopt only when a trigger holds' gate at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Adopt **event sourcing** when one of these is concretely true:

judged.note: Kept: the rule restricts event sourcing to when one of the same two triggers (replay/audit requirement; deriving new read models retroactively) is concretely true, with all examples kept.

moved.sentence: | Eventual consistency | Read models lag writes; UI/API **MUST** tolerate the delay (optimistic update, loading state, or read-your-writes routing). |

judged.note: Kept verbatim: read models lag writes and the UI/API MUST tolerate the delay, with all three techniques listed.

moved.sentence: | Projection rebuilds | A documented, tested procedure to rebuild read models from the log; **MUST** be runnable without downtime for large stores. |

judged.note: Kept: a documented, tested rebuild procedure from the log, MUST be runnable without downtime for large stores.

moved.sentence: | Event versioning | Events are immutable once written; you **MUST** have an upcasting/versioning plan before the first event ships — schema changes are not retroactive edits. |

judged.note: Kept verbatim: events immutable once written, MUST have an upcasting/versioning plan before the first event ships, schema changes not retroactive edits.

moved.sentence: | Operational surface | Command handlers, event store, projectors, and read stores each add deployment, monitoring, and failure modes (`manage-complexity-through-boundaries`). |

judged.note: Kept verbatim inside should-plan-for-each-cost-before-adopting: each component adds deployment, monitoring and failure modes, with the manage-complexity-through-boundaries reference.

moved.sentence: **explicit-over-implicit**: model commands and events as named, versioned types; never overload one generic "update" event.

judged.note: Kept: named, versioned types at SHOULD (unkeyed instruction) and the ban on overloading one generic update event strengthened to MUST NOT, both citing explicit-over-implicit.

moved.sentence: **idempotency**: command handlers and projectors **MUST** be idempotent — events may be redelivered; dedupe on a stable event id.

judged.note: Kept verbatim: handlers and projectors MUST be idempotent, with the redelivery reason and stable-event-id dedupe.

moved.sentence: Keep CQRS **without** event sourcing as a valid stopping point: separating read/write models in one database is far cheaper than a full event store, and often enough.

judged.note: Kept verbatim at SHOULD, including the reason that one-database read/write separation is far cheaper than a full event store and often enough.

moved.sentence: Start in-process and single-store; introduce separate read stores or message infrastructure **only** when the triggering requirement demands it.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: start in-process and single-store, introduce separate read stores or messaging only when the triggering requirement demands it.

moved.sentence: Define the consistency contract per use case (which reads may be stale, which must be strongly consistent) and surface it in the API.

judged.note: Kept verbatim at SHOULD: per-use-case consistency contract naming stale vs strongly consistent reads, surfaced in the API.

moved.sentence: Default to a single model (CRUD over one datastore).

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: default to a single model (CRUD over one datastore).
